attributes.board_name: Alabama Board of Medical Examiners & Medical Licensure Commission

rules.unit: AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, AOA Category 1-A credits or equivalent
rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA PRA Category 1 Credits (ACCME- or Medical Association of the State of Alabama-accredited providers); AOA Category 1-A; equivalents: AAFP prescribed hours, ACOG cognates, completion of an ABMS board certification or MOC process (credited to the year completed)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt in the calendar year of initial licensure; the 2-hour professional boundaries course must be completed within 12 months of licensure.
rules.alternatives: Exempt: physicians who neither reside nor practice in Alabama, retirement or disability waiver, residents/clinical fellows in that calendar year, deployed military. Certifying board certificates alone generally do not satisfy the 25 credits.
rules.audit_note: Random annual audit; do not send certificates unless requested. Keep CME records 3 years after the year earned.

topics.who: Holders of an Alabama Controlled Substances Certificate (ACSC); AMA PRA Category 1 in controlled substance prescribing, recognizing abuse/misuse, or chronic pain prescribing; per two calendar years
All active licensees: Board-provided course "Navigating Professional Boundaries in Medicine" (due by Dec 31, 2025; new licensees within 12 months)

rules.notes: Licenses expire annually Dec 31 (grace to Jan 31 with late fee); CME counts per calendar year. Physicians collaborating with CRNPs/supervising PAs must also take a Board-prescribed course (60-month look-back). Credits used for one year cannot be reused next year.
